Tests: 20m sprint, broad jump, single-leg hop, line-touch, soccer wall passes

Build-ups, then 6×10m starts from athletic stance

days.name: Land Like a Cat
blocks: Animal walk medley: bear, crab, monkey, flamingo, giraffe, 10m each. Then 10 skips.

Stick landing from the ground. Jump up, land in <q>cat position</q>: feet quiet, knees over toes, chest up, hands out front. Freeze 3 seconds. 10 reps, Dad scores each 1 to 3 for quiet. Then 10 from a curb or bottom step.
Bunny hops over a chalk line. Hands on the line, kick both feet over to the other side, land feet together. 10 each direction. <q>Arms straight, look at your hands.</q>

Stationary handling, eyes up on Dad's fingers (he holds up numbers, Teddy calls them). Pound dribble 25 each hand, crossovers 25, figure 8 through the legs 10 each way, then again. About 200 dribbles. Ball below the waist. <q>Eyes up, ball low.</q>
Silent Landings. 10 jumps off the step. Count how many make no sound. Write the number on the chart. Again Friday.
First entry. One line: best thing today. Teddy writes it himself.
Skateboard cruise or bike. Nothing timed.
days.dad: Gym already loaded him. Zero sprinting and zero jumping for distance today. The basketball block is volume, not intensity: 200 dribbles is the target, and losing the ball is fine, looking down is the thing to correct. Watch the knees on landing: if they cave inward, lower the step.

days.name: Test Day 1: Hands & Arms
blocks: Skips, big and small arm circles, bear crawl 2×10m, inchworms ×5.
Against a wall, shoes off, heels down. Record cm. Repeat at every retest.
Best of 2, 2 min rest between. Straight arms, thumbs around the bar. Record seconds.
Tennis ball, from a step. 3 throws right, 3 throws left. Mark the best with a cone, pace it. Record both arms.
Consecutive singles without a miss. Best of 3. Record.
Each leg, eyes open, arms out, up to 60s. Record each leg (skill unlock, not a battery item).
Riverside traveling rings. Hang and swing ×5. Then reach for the next ring with Dad spotting the hips. Goal: 3 passes. If he gets 3, try for 5.

At a wall. Pass, receive, pass: 25 with the right foot, 25 with the left. Then toe taps 30s, tick-tocks 30s, sole rolls 30s, twice through. About 300 touches. <q>Soft foot, look up after the touch.</q>
Basketball court. HORSE, Dad shoots from one spot.
days.dad: Tests before rings, while he is fresh. Full rest between throws; these are max efforts. Cheer the effort, record the number without commentary. The non-dominant arm and the left foot will look bad. That is the point: they are what will move most this year. Swim class after is recovery, add nothing.

days.name: Test Day 2: Fast & Far
blocks: A-march 2×15m, skips 2×15m, gallops each lead 2×15m, high knees 2×10m. Then 3 build-up runs over 20m at 60, 70, 80%.
Standing start behind a line, Dad at 20m with the phone timer: <q>ready, set, go</q>. 3 trials, walk-back rest of 2 min. Record best.
Toes behind the line, arm swing, jump, must stick the landing to count. 3 trials. Measure to the back heel. Record best.
Each leg, 2 trials, stick the landing on the same leg. Record both.
Cones at 0 and 5m. Sprint out, touch, back, touch, out. 2 trials. Record best.
Ready position and split step. Feet wider than shoulders, knees soft, hands ready. Dad claps, Teddy does a tiny hop-and-land, then points where Dad points. 15 reps. <q>Land ready.</q>
Inside-foot passing to a cone gate at 3m, 20 each foot. Then Test: soccer wall passes, 30 seconds alternating feet, count controlled returns. Record.
Bear walk 2×15m, crab walk 2×10m, 2 dead hangs.
Beat Dad's Broad Jump. Dad jumps from kneeling. Teddy tries to beat the mark from standing. Best of 3.
Soccer field. Roll-out sharks and minnows: Dad is the stationary shark, rolling balls to tag. Then free kicking at a goal.
Walk a lap, calves on the wall, Champion's Log line.
days.dad: High-intent efforts today: 3 sprints, 3 jumps, 4 hops, 2 shuttles, 3 challenge jumps, about 15. That is the week's load spike, by design. The soccer passing is technical volume and does not count. If he is flat on the third sprint, take the best of two and move on.

days.name: Wall & Ball
blocks: Animal medley, skips, then 10 shadow forehands and 10 shadow backhands with a full unit turn.

Cartwheel step 2: <q>hand, hand, foot, foot</q>. Chalk a line. Lunge, reach hand then hand onto the line, kick one foot over then the other, land on the line. 8 each side. Then 10 donkey kicks against the wall.
Step-and-throw at a big chalk square on the tennis wall. Opposite foot steps forward. 15 throws dominant, 10 non-dominant. Score the hits.

Drop-feed forehands ×20: unit turn, contact in front, finish over the shoulder. Drop-feed backhands ×20. Wall rally: how many in a row? Then Test: rally count with Dad, cooperative, green ball, best of 3. Record. Introduce the between-point reset: breathe, bounce, look at the strings.

Jump stop from a jog, then pivot on each foot, 5 each. Triple-threat stance. Chest passes to a chalk square at 3m ×15, bounce passes ×15. Then Test: cone weave, 5 cones 2m apart, right hand down, left hand back. 2 trials. Record.
Wall Rally Streak. Longest unbroken streak against the wall. Record.
Basketball. Dribble tag with Dad stationary and a ball to roll, then HORSE.
days.dad: Form over volume on the tennis. If the finish starts dropping, stop the set at 10, not 20. The basketball cone weave will be slow with the left hand; record it without comment. High-intent efforts stay near zero today.

days.name: Skate & Stick
blocks: Free skate. One 5-minute safe-fall lesson: bend the knees, roll onto the side and forearm, never straight arms. Practice from kneeling on grass ×5.
Single-leg stick. Small hop forward, land on one leg, statue for 3 seconds. 5 each leg. Then hop sideways ×5 each.

On grass. Ready position: knees bent, hands in front, weight forward. Dad hand-feeds 20 balls at chest height for the W-catch (thumbs together behind the ball), then 20 rolling balls for the scoop. No diving yet. <q>Hands first, then hug it.</q>
Jump rope, 2 rounds of 2 minutes. <q>Tiny hops, wrists not arms.</q>
Silent Landings, round 2. 10 jumps off Monday's step. Beat Monday's number.
Soccer field kickaround and passing games. No sprint races today.
Calves, hamstrings. Champion's Log: <q>what was your best thing this week?</q>
days.dad: Saturday is roughly 5 hours of organized sport. Today is balance and skill, high-intent efforts 5 or fewer. Keeper work is catching only this block; diving starts from kneeling in the Fox block once the safe-fall habit is in. Early bed, big dinner, water bottle ready for tomorrow.

days.name: Soccer · Lacrosse · Tennis
blocks: Walk, calves against the wall, 3 slow breaths. Champion's Log line: one thing from each sport.
days.dad: Highest-load day of the week. Watch for heel or knee complaints Sunday morning. If there are any, Sunday's card becomes stretching only and you tell me.

days.name: Ceremony
blocks: Skips, 10 shadow forehands, 10 shadow backhands. Remind him of the reset: breathe, bounce, strings.
Cartwheel step 1 again: bunny hops over a line ×10. Compare with Monday.
Stationary handling, 200 dribbles, eyes on Dad's fingers. Finish with 10 chest passes to a target.
Sit down with the test sheet. Read every number to Teddy, height included. Draw the Cub rank card with nine empty patch slots. Ask him which patch he wants first.
days.dad: This is the ceremony moment. The numbers are his, the card is his. Next week's theme is Stick It.
